posts.trend: Daughter's school admission cancelled after paying Rs 21,000 admission fee; refund denied despite no class
posts.context: Modern preschools have structured non-refundable fees like premium hospitality, turning parenting into a series of luxury transactions.
posts.angle: Every stage of your child's education is just a non-refundable booking deposit for a future you cannot afford.
slides: A school just charged ₹21,000 to cancel a class that never even started.

No books bought.
No uniform stitched.
No desk sat on.
No attendance marked.

But the fee is non-refundable.

Your child has learned their first lesson about the Indian education system.
posts.caption: Send this to the parent who is currently managing three different nursery admission spreadsheets. 🏫
posts.rank_verdict: The landing moralizes and explains the joke to the reader instead of delivering a sharp comic turn.
